test_cases.expected_result: reading 1: nothing (disabled); reading 2: it spends 350 gems on a refill
test_cases.confirms_if: it spends gems with nothing visible having said so
test_cases.overturns_if: a confirmation naming the cost appears first
test_cases.observed_result: not run: tapping could spend 350 gems (safety rule: no spending currency)

screen5-a3.deciding_evidence: PROVISIONAL — not tested (would risk spending gems); visible text does not say what is recharged or that 350 is a price
screen5-a3.recommendation: spell it out: 'Refill energy to 25 — 350 gems', and say why it is unavailable when greyed ('Energy is full')

screen5-a4.deciding_evidence: INSTALL opened a plain explanation of adding a home-screen widget, which is what the words 'Widget … INSTALL' lead to
